verdict.rationale: Ollama's blog states it is compatible with the Anthropic Messages API, so developers can point Anthropic clients such as Claude Code at the server. Other first-party material on connecting Claude Code to Ollama corroborates that this is a real use case. missing for 10: dedicated endpoint documentation (path, request/response shape, supported features such as tools and streaming), documented limitations of the compatibility subset, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can call the server through an Anthropic-compatible messages endpoint

citations.quote: Ollama is now compatible with the Anthropic Messages API, making it possible to use tools like Claude Code with open models.
